newsitem.title: USA: Miller Petroleum extends natgas field.
newsitem.headline: Miller Petroleum extends natgas field.

text.p: Miller Petroleum Inc said the Robert Cox 2, an offset confirmation to the Cox 1 well, tested 707,000 cubic feet of natural gas per day from the Big Lime at 1970 to 2056 feet.
This most recent Campbell County, Tenn., well extends the Jellico Field limits westward about one mile, Miller said.
A direct offset well, the Robert Cox 3, is now being surveyed. It will be operated by Miller Petroleum, which owns 50 percent of the working interest.

"The additional wells to be drilled on the Cox lease, along with selected locations on the approximately 9,000 acres currently held by production in the Jellico area, gives us a good start for our 1997 drilling program," the company said.
Present plans include a gas transportation system, now being programmed, and several new development wells to be drilled in the area. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
